name: CONVEX_MIRROR_AHEAD_YELLOW_SQUARE
notes: TMR Queensland design sheet (Q-series book / TC-series), colour drawing 'not to scale' with a lettered dimension table; every dimension from the sheet, AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. The sheets give no letter widths, so there is no width check. Sheet 'c' is the white edge and 'd' the edge + border (read as AS 1743 does: 10/30 = edge 10 + border 20, 5/15 = 5 + 10, 15/45 = 15 + 30), confirmed against the national R-series pairs. TC-series sheet TC1274 'Convex mirror ahead' supplementary warning sign (2001/2007), installed below a warning sign. Size TC1274A 600 x 550 generated (B 750 x 700 also tabled): r 75, c 8 / d 24 (yellow edge 8 + black border 16), e 70, f 100DN, g 55, h 55. Chain e 70 / f 100 / h 55 / f 100 / g 55 / f 100 / e 70 = 550: cap tops CONVEX 70, MIRROR 225, AHEAD 380, all 100 Series D ('DN' = the sheet's 'AS1744 Series D Narrow' read as plain D), centred. The sheet draws the panel 560 tall (not to scale); the table's 550 governs. Black on retroreflective yellow.
